EC1: Had dose increase of anti-TNF agent [OR] or DMARD in the last 6 months
EC2: Had change of anti-TNF agent [OR] or DMARD in the last 6 months
EC3: Treated currently with golimumab [OR] or certolizumab
EC4: Treated with greater than 10 mg of prednisone (or equivalent) daily in the last 6 months
EC5: Treated with greater than 5 mg of prednisone (or equivalent) daily in the last 3 months
EC6: Treated with intramuscular [OR] or intravenous corticosteroids in the last 6 months for RA activity
EC7: Treated with anakinra [OR], abatacept [OR], or tocilizumab in the last 6 months
EC8: Treated with rituximab in the last 12 months
EC9: Treated with an investigational RA drug in the last 6 months
EC10: Pregnant  (or anticipate pregnancy during the study period) [OR] or lactating women
EC11: [NOT] Absence of documentation in the medical record of clinical remission for the last 6 months
EC13: [NOT] Absence of documentation of negative tuberculin skin test, negative QuantiFERON-TB Gold test, or treatment [AND] for latent tuberculosis prior to starting treatment with the anti-TNF agent
EC14: Treatment of solid malignancy [OR] or non-melanoma skin cancer  within the past 5 years [OR], or any history of melanoma [OR] or hematologic [OR] or lymphoproliferative malignancy
EC15: Absence of documentation of age-appropriate cancer screening at the time of randomization
EC16: [NOT] Absence of documentation of negative hepatitis B serologies [OR], [NOT] absence of completion of treatment [AND] for chronic hepatitis B [OR], or [NOT] absence of suppressive antiviral treatment
EC18: Anticipate not being available or able to comply with the schedule of study visits
